subject_rule: AMENAZA belongs to the taxon and must not be duplicated as a population, locality, collection or accession property.
definition: Nivel de amenaza/conservacion atribuido al taxon a partir de evidencia externa fiable, auditable y versionada, calculado exclusivamente por el proveedor analitico 05 mediante el modelo de scoring declarado.

provider.rule: STIMES consumes provider output; it does not reimplement or silently alter scoring.

authorized_sources.future_rule: When direct authenticated IUCN acquisition is available it becomes the preferred direct global source; previously acquired indirect evidence is retained.

scoring.scale: 0-100 when evaluable; null/UNKNOWN when not evaluable
scoring.aggregation: 0.8 * highest weighted assessment + 0.2 * mean(up to three highest distinct logical-unit weighted assessments), cap 100

territorial_views.original_category_rule: Excel territorial columns show source-original categories; internal normalized codes never overwrite them.
territorial_views.conflict_display_rule: Multiple valid categories for the same displayed scope are joined with ' / ' and no extra CONFLICTO label.

conflict_policy.provider_rule: Same logical unit and version with incompatible evaluable categories is UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT; preserve all; scoring projection uses precautionary maximum evaluable severity.
conflict_policy.history_rule: No conflicting evidence is deleted or overwritten.

reliability.requested_formula: sum(weights of checked components) / sum(total component weights) * 100
reliability.checked_component_rule: A component is checked only when acquisition succeeded, taxonomic identity is sufficiently resolved, source is authorized, and the evidence is auditable to source and method.
reliability.reason_pending: AMENAZA_SCORING_MODEL_v1_2 does not define a reliability model and the prompt does not provide exact thresholds or component weights. STIMES must not invent them.
reliability.double_penalty_rule: Source quality is resolved during source/evidence selection and must not be penalized a second time in reliability.

on_taxon_query.rule: A taxon-specific request must not be treated as an AMENAZA-only refresh when other automatically refreshable LOCALIZACION_Y_SELECCION items exist.

dependencies.reason: Dependent item formulas are outside this execution and must not be invented or implemented while AMENAZA is the only authorized item.

storage_mapping.subject: taxonomy/core taxon resource referenced by analytics.analysis_result.subject_resource_id
storage_mapping.rule: AMENAZA is versioned analytical enrichment, not a permanent mutable column on population/locality/collection/accession.

excel_view.evidence_column_rule: Display one short auditable reference to the principal assessment actually used; complete trace remains internal.
excel_view.latest_update_rule: One date representing the latest valid integral update of AMENAZA for the taxon.

incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.prompt_requirement: La Rioja -> España -> Europa -> Mundial -> Subsidiario; use the first evaluable scope
incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.existing_model: AMENAZA_SCORING_MODEL_v1_2 aggregates multiple weighted logical units and does not select one first-available territorial scope.
incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.effect: A single Ámbito efectivo cannot be populated truthfully from v1_2 without defining a new presentation semantic or changing the scoring model.

incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.prompt_requirement: Use provisional numeric zero when an unchecked component needs a number
incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.existing_model: AMENAZA_SCORING_MODEL_v1_2 maps missing/non-evaluable states to null/UNKNOWN.
incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.effect: STIMES never injects provisional zero into AMENAZA scoring v1_2.

incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.prompt_requirement: Display at most two decimals without changing internal precision
incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.existing_model: The current 05 scorer writes the final amenaza_score rounded to two decimals.
incompatibilities_preserved_by_precedenc.effect: Higher precision is not currently available to STIMES from this provider output.
